objective: Separate proposition discovery/alignment from governed classification without treating model silence, ledger omission, or creative framing as proof of safety.
non_objectives: No commentary generation or factual-summary generation.
No replacement of immutable factual authority.
No lexical routing or deterministic semantic inference.
No Gate S, Core/Voice generation, curriculum, runtime, production, or training change.

architecture.stage_c_additional_input: Validated but untrusted Stage P ledger
architecture.independence_rule: Stage C receives original authority and candidate and must audit ledger completeness; it may not treat the ledger as factual authority.

stage_p.task: Inventory and align every real-world proposition carried by assertion, presupposition, entailment, or necessary implication, while marking contained creative material and unresolved scope. Do not decide admission and do not emit FSEM codes.
complete_invariants: coverage_decision COMPLETE requires all coverage receipt booleans except unresolved_scope_present to be true and unresolved_scope_present false.
COMPLETE is invalid when any entry is UNRESOLVED_SCOPE or contains an UNRESOLVED enum.
An empty entries array cannot be COMPLETE; fact-safe commentary must still ledger the contained creative or editorial material that explains why no real-world commitment was extracted.
Every material real-world commitment must have its own entry or share an explicit independence_group with other dimensions of the same proposition.
Stage P must not select Gate F decision or reason codes.
stage_p.case_01_expected_shape: At least one CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry grounding the hotel/room/transparency transformation, no unsupported REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT, COMPLETE coverage.
stage_p.case_10_expected_shape: REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT entries or grouped dimensions for rules changed during the event and the test deciding young people's future, aligned against possible future rules, COMPLETE coverage.

allowed_checks: Unique entry_id and valid independence_group references.
Every non-null candidate_span is a byte-exact contiguous candidate substring.
Every non-null authority_support is a byte-exact contiguous factual-summary substring.
Input, prompt, raw-output, and ledger identity binding.
prohibited_checks: No inference that an omitted proposition does or does not exist.
No automatic FSEM mapping from modality/timing enums.
No semantic correction, span repair, normalization, entry insertion, deletion, merging, or relabeling.
No conversion of model silence to COMPLETE.
deterministic_ledger_validation.failure: Any violation produces STAGE_P_VALIDATION_FAILURE and final fail-closed abstention; Stage C is not called.

stage_c.task: Audit Stage P completeness against the original authority and candidate, then classify every unsupported real-world proposition using governed FSEM codes and decisive/supporting status.
required_internal_sequence: Re-read original candidate and authority, including presupposition, entailment, and necessary implication.
Check whether Stage P omitted, mis-scoped, or misaligned any material proposition.
If ledger completeness cannot be affirmed, return INDETERMINATE with ADMISSION_INDETERMINATE; do not repair the ledger.
For complete ledgers, compare matched event axes before open-class labels.
Group dimensions of one proposition and assign the minimal core contradiction DECISIVE; material additional dimensions SUPPORTING.
PASS only after explicit completeness audit and no unsupported real-world proposition.
stage_c.output: Existing strict Gate F decision/reason schema, subject to zero-inference compatibility and source-span validation.
stage_c.omission_rule: Stage P omission is never evidence of safety. A detected or suspected omission yields INDETERMINATE rather than PASS.
stage_c.new_finding_rule: Stage C may reject based on a proposition visible in the originals even if omitted by Stage P, but must mark ledger completeness failure in a separate evaluation receipt; it may not silently amend Stage P evidence.
pass_requirements: All contained creative entries remain nonfactual after factual-return review.
All reason spans, if any, pass source-membership validation.

call_ceiling.unused_call_budget: Never consumed after an earlier terminal abstention.

durability_and_receipts.provider_boundary: Persist each raw provider response or exception before schema or semantic validation.
durability_and_receipts.stage_p_receipt: Bind input hashes, prompt/model/grammar identities, raw bytes, parse result, source checks, coverage decision, and validation failures.
durability_and_receipts.stage_c_receipt: Bind original inputs, Stage P raw and validated identities, prompt/model/grammar identities, raw bytes, completeness audit, decision, reason records, source checks, and failures.
durability_and_receipts.aggregate_receipt: Bind precedence path, calls consumed, unused budget, final Gate F decision, and quarantine status.

case_01.stage_p: COMPLETE with grounded CONTAINED_CREATIVE coverage and no unsupported real-world commitment.
case_01.stage_c: PASS with no reasons after independent completeness audit.

case_10.stage_p: COMPLETE ledger carrying certainty/timing mutation and life-stakes commitments with source-valid spans and correct grouping.
case_10.stage_c: FAIL: certainty DECISIVE; timing and life-stakes SUPPORTING; no causality or motive; source-valid spans.

bounded_proof_contract.acceptance: Both stages and final outcomes must match exactly for both cases; any abstention, unsafe pass, false rejection, wrong reason/status, omission, invalid span, transport failure, or extra call fails the proof.
bounded_proof_contract.full_ten_case_eligibility: Requires separate owner adjudication and authority after exact two-case proof success.

risks_and_controls.risk: Stage P omission creates false safety.
risks_and_controls.control: Stage C independent completeness audit; omission cannot imply PASS; unresolved completeness abstains.
Ledger remains untrusted; Stage C receives originals; deterministic validation checks source spans only.
Stage P cannot decide or emit FSEM codes; Stage C owns classification; exact positive anchor required.
Immutable raw capture, no mutation, explicit identities, fail-closed validation.
No case labels or expected reasons in prompts; later hidden paired near-miss extension required before runtime consideration.
Hard two-call maximum and one-call early abstention; measure timing during separately authorized proof.

implementation_sequence_if_separately_au: Freeze Stage P schema, grammar, prompt, and identities.
Freeze Stage C staged-input contract and prompt identity; preserve existing Gate F output grammar if compatible.
Implement evaluation-only provider-boundary raw capture and deterministic ledger validation with no production import edge.
Add property and regression tests for completeness invariants, source membership, grouping references, early abstention, call ceiling, and no-repair behavior.
Perform zero-inference construction and tokenizer/trie feasibility only.
Stop for owner review before any four-call proof.
